Slatebridge’s Meridian Facilities Group saw overtime hours plummet 18% and SLA compliance soar from 87% to 96% in six months. Now their dispatchers have ditched whiteboards for the software. Unbundle those numbers: each technician saved over three hours of overtime, and nearly every SLA met without a hiccup.

Meridian’s ops director says, "I used to spend my mornings untangling the schedule. Now I spend them on customers."

The key? Automatic job assignment by skill and location, replacing manual whiteboard tracking with real-time compliance. Meridian isn't just using software; they're streamlining their operations so dispatching feels like a natural part of their day.

Next time you face scheduling chaos, ditch the spreadsheets and try Slatebridge.
